cases.purpose: Force three partial output timeouts and verify exact resumption of one 16384-byte event.
cases.setup_script: /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import hashlib,os; a=bytes((i*73+19)%256 for i in range(32768+45)); b=bytes((i*37+11)%256 for i in range(16384)); assert len(a)==32813 and len(b)==16384 and 0 in a and max(a)>127; assert hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()=="d5b60ff71ffd82d71e5cda06bb82482785283d64a95c7144049a61ed1d96cdb9" and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=="ce61cc72a84bd3526a8f955235c5f4f67439820d6ffb910b5ab07e54741262b8"; m,s=os.openpty(); assert os.isatty(m) and os.isatty(s); os.close(m); os.close(s)'
cases.oracle: Documented broker contract, independently created fixed bytes and Linux PTY/process observations. Setup controls the PTY facility and exact expected byte hashes; no candidate output defines expected behavior.
cases.comparison: The independent private SOCK_SEQPACKET peer supplies one known 16384-byte output event; a kernel FIFO fixed to 4096 bytes forces three timeouts and the final successful receive. Four drained chunks must equal the original bytes exactly.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/terra-local-pty-broker-r2.py
root=$HOME/broker-root
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prepare || exit 1
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$root" || exit 1
failed=0
mark() { if [[ $2 == 1 ]]; then printf '%s=PASS\n' "$1"; else printf '%s=FAIL\n' "$1"; failed=1; fi; }
await_file() { local j; for ((j=0;j<100;j++)); do [[ -f $HOME/$1 ]] && return 0; /usr/bin/sleep .05; done; return 1; }
trap 'ptybroker terminate "$root" one >/dev/null 2>&1 || :' EXIT

/usr/bin/mkfifo -m 600 "$HOME/fifo" || exit 1
exec 9<>"$HOME/fifo"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" pipe-size 9 9>&9 >"$HOME/pipe.log" 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" peer >"$HOME/mock-stdout.log" 2>"$HOME/mock-stderr.log" & mock=$!
trap 'ptybroker detach "$h" >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; if [[ -n ${mock:-} ]]; then kill "$mock" 2>/dev/null || :; wait "$mock" 2>/dev/null || :; fi; ptybroker terminate "$root" one >/dev/null 2>&1 || :' EXIT
await_file mock-ready || exit 1
ptybroker attach "$HOME/mock-root" one control h 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
ptybroker receive "$h" 9 ev 3000 2>>"$HOME/errors.log" || exit 1
[[ $ev == attached\ * ]] || exit 1
timeouts=1; last=1
for ((i=1;i<=4;i++)); do
  ptybroker receive "$h" 9 ev 200 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; rc=$?
  printf '%s %s\n' "$i" "$rc" >>"$HOME/partial-status.log"
  if ((i<4)); then [[ $rc == 124 ]] || timeouts=0; else [[ $rc == 0 && $ev == 'output size=16384 offset=0' ]] || last=0; fi
  /usr/bin/python3 "$H" drain 9 "$HOME/part-$i" 4096 9<&9 >>"$HOME/drain.log" 2>&1 || { timeouts=0; last=0; break; }
done
mark partial-prefix-timeouts "$timeouts"
mark remainder-completes "$last"
/usr/bin/cat "$HOME/part-1" "$HOME/part-2" "$HOME/part-3" "$HOME/part-4" >"$HOME/partial-combined" 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"
good=0; /usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/expected-partial" "$HOME/partial-combined" && good=1
mark resumed-byte-exact "$good"
ptybroker detach "$h" 2>>"$HOME/errors.log"; detach_rc=$?
wait "$mock"; peer_rc=$?; mock=''
good=0; [[ $detach_rc == 0 && $peer_rc == 0 && -f $HOME/mock-log.json && $(<"$HOME/mock-log.json") == *'"error": null'* ]] && good=1
mark independent-peer-validated "$good"
exec 9>&-
exit "$failed"
